name: Kestrel Reach
projection: orthographic dimetric, yaw 45 deg, pitch 30 deg (2:1)

arena.shape: world square |x|,|y| <= half_extent, projected as a screen diamond

symmetry: 180 degree rotation about (0,0); maps each spawn corner onto the other
draw_order: descending (x + y): larger is further from the camera

sun.note: props are baked per light bucket and falloff tier, then placed with the pair matching their true bearing and distance to the sun

traversal_check.method: occupancy grid flood fill along each corridor, spawn to spawn
